request.style: English, bright female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, gentle percussion, warm mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Seven princes sat beside the throne
Persia and Media all their own
Memucan stood among the wise
To judge the matter in their eyes

[Pre-Chorus]
The king was merry with wine
Vashti refused to come
Anger burned within his soul
Who shall decide what shall be done

[Chorus]
Let the decree go out to all
Written in the laws of the land
Vashti shall not come before the king
Another shall take her place instead

[Verse]
She wronged the king and all the peoples
In every province far and near
The women will hear of her refusal
And despise their husbands here

[Pre-Chorus]
From the greatest to the least they go
Honor their husbands from now on
The law is set and cannot change
The king's command is the law

[Chorus]
Let the decree go out to all
Written in the laws of the land
Vashti shall not come before the king
Another shall take her place instead

[Bridge]
Letters sent to every land
In each script and every tongue
Every man shall be master of his house
The kingdom's order is sung

[Chorus]
Let the decree go out to all
Written in the laws of the land
Vashti shall not come before the king
Another shall take her place instead

[Outro]
Memucan's advice pleased the king
The royal decree was signed
